scope: Existing Pineland project artifacts only. This ledger does not claim that relevant external evidence does not exist; it records whether such evidence has already been acquired/coded into the project.

forbidden_search_inputs: districts selected because Pineland underpredicts or overpredicts them
mechanisms selected because a historical target would improve
source inclusion conditional on agreement with model state
permitted_search_inputs: case identity and preregistered study dates
outcome construct and required fields in outcome_measurement_contract.json
calendar-time coverage gaps defined without model values
anti_selection_rule.rule: Any newly inspected historical source must be appended to a later exposure-ledger version whether it supports, contradicts, or is unusable for Pineland.

evidence_classes.direct_measurement: Historical source directly observes the contracted outcome or a declared component at an admissible geography/time.
evidence_classes.observation_input: Historical data are used as inputs/covariates or observation-process evidence but do not by themselves validate another latent construct.
evidence_classes.proxy_only: Historical signal exists but the measurement contract forbids using it as the target outcome.
evidence_classes.synthetic_only: Evidence comes from synthetic Pineland worlds or structural tests, not historical observation.
evidence_classes.model_output: Pineland output; never an empirical source.
evidence_classes.missing_in_project: No eligible historical measurement artifact for the contracted outcome is currently registered in the project.
